title: Venue lead
description: A possible venue (or news about a known one) found by a venue finder in the weekly venue run. One file per lead at data/venue-leads/<run-date>/<finder>-<id>.json. A lead is not published: the triage script and the venue editor decide what happens to it. Every lead needs at least one word-for-word quote from a page anyone can open.

id.description: Lowercase slug of the venue's name, hyphens only ("the-mayfly-bar" → "mayfly-bar": drop a leading 'the'). For a known venue, its existing id.

about_venue_id.description: When the lead is news about a venue we already know (closing, renamed, reopened), that venue's id. Otherwise null.

signal.description: new = a venue we don't list; opening-soon / reopened / closed / temporarily-closed / renamed = news a source states about it.

kind_hint.description: What the source says it is, in a few words of our own ("pub with live music upstairs", "basement club"). Not a judgement.

google_place_id.description: Only from scripts/places_search.py. Google's terms let us keep the place id but nothing else from Google: names, addresses and descriptions must come from the evidence quotes.
